title: Financial postings, FX và cost snapshots
scope_items: Database Migration 00007: Added 4 PostgreSQL 17 tables (settlements, settlement_lines, cost_items, profit_snapshots) with full Row Level Security (ENABLE/FORCE RLS), tenant isolation policies, strict foreign key references, and exact decimal money types (NUMERIC(18,6)).

Protobuf Contracts & Multi-Target Generation: Defined 3 canonical services (ProfitService, SettlementService, CostService) with 10 RPCs. Compiled and verified cleanly across all 4 targets (Go, Connect-Go, TypeScript, Dart) with zero codegen drift.
Acceptance Target 1: Golden Fixtures F01–F09 implemented and passing under race conditions:

- F01: Completed order profit recognition with 8 separate active posting components (gross revenue, platform fee, shipping, COGS, AI generation, affiliate commission, ad spend, seeding) summing to exact net profit 375,000 VND.
- F02: Partial refund preserves recognized gross revenue while posting an explicit refund component netting to 275,000 VND.
- F03: Settlement fee deduplication ensures platform settlement fee supersedes estimated order fee via reversal posting rather than accumulating doubly.
- F04: Historical FX rate preservation freezes transaction base amount snapshot (25,000 VND/USD); subsequent rate fluctuations do not alter historical base amounts.
- F05: Pending orders separate unearned revenue/cost into pending buckets; recognized profit remains zero until order completion.
- F06: Replay idempotency and order correction via reversal postings replaces prior fee without duplicating recognized order revenue.
- F07: Missing COGS is never verified or defaulted to zero; flags is_incomplete=true, unknown_required_components_count>0, confidence=low.
- F08: Multi-line partial settlement strictly caps total matched amount at order total (1,000,000 VND) and rejects over-allocation.
- F09: Source confidence mixing inherits lowest contributing component (mixed official high and estimated/inferred low forces aggregate low confidence).
Acceptance Target 2: Settlement fee not duplicated. Settlement lines with matching order fees create reversal postings for estimated fees, maintaining clean net proof.
Acceptance Target 3: Missing COGS never verified zero. Proof engine strictly prohibits assuming zero cost of goods sold.
Concurrency & Race Safety: All financial calculations and store operations pass -race test suite cleanly with zero data races.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestF01 through TestF09 in apps/api/internal/finance/fixtures_f01_f09_test.go pass with 100% clean race checks.
Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestF03SettlementFeeDeduplication confirms settlement fee replaces estimated fee via reversal without double-counting.
Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestF07MissingCOGSNeverVerifiedZero confirms missing COGS marks snapshot incomplete with low confidence and non-zero unknown components count.
Reversal & Correction Verified: TestF06ReplayAndCorrection confirms correction postings net out prior postings cleanly.
FX Historical Immutability Verified: TestF04ExchangeRatePreservation confirms base currency calculations remain frozen to historical rates.
ConnectRPC Handlers Verified: ProfitServiceHandler, SettlementServiceHandler, and CostServiceHandler compile and bind cleanly.
external_gates: External Platform Settlement Feeds (TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada): Live settlement report download and OAuth sync are unconfigured in local hermetic environment; settlement CSV/JSON parser and match engine verified with local fixtures.
Live FX Rate API Providers: Real-time FX polling service remains external; historical exchange rate snapshot immutability is fully verified locally.
PostgreSQL 17 Database Service: Local PostgreSQL service container runs in GitHub CI; live migration rollback tests validate SQL migration 00007.
remaining_scope: P1-04: Reconciliation, evidence và repair queue (match capacity, immutable proof chain, permission-filtered data gaps).
P1-05: First-value loop và payment replay.
notes: P1-03 Financial postings, FX and cost snapshots implementation complete. Migration 00007 deployed and verified. Golden fixtures F01-F09 pass with zero race conditions. Settlement fee deduplication and missing COGS confidence handling verified.
